_source: ATT-D2D-OOF SOW Schedule A (eff 09.01.2026) + Change Notice eff 10.07.2026 (kzeller@thesmartcircle.com, 'ATT D2D OOF SOW-Eff.10.07.2026 (Sched A).pdf', extracted 2026-10-09). Carlos 2026-10-09: 'use the NDS SOW ... and assume base comp for now.'
_base_comp_note: BASE COMP = Churn Tier 3-3 for both port charts — the AUTOMATIC tier when the ICD has 19 or fewer port (resp. BYOD) activations in the month, which is where the crew's volume sits. When volume clears 19/month the real 0-30 x 90-day churn tier applies and these two numbers must move (full Chart 2/4 grids are in the PDF in output/fiber_metrics).

addons._protect_note: Smart Circle 11/3/2026 'Device Protection (PA) - Bonus Removal Effective 11/3': the $10 (PA1) / $25 (PA4) bonus is gone for sales from 11/3; the $15 / $50 base stays. SaraPlus shows no protection feature anywhere we read (SOH export, wireless report, customer card) -- not priced on the board.

internet_air._note: the 10/07/2026 Change Notice re-declared Section 2(b)(ii)(a) — this $93 is the post-change amount

exclusions: VoIP-carrier ports (Bandwidth.com etc.) are not paid
activated-and-disconnected same week excluded from the DD

rep_tier._source: Sean Balderrama (Smart Circle) 10/19/2026 'Re: NDS - Commission Grid': 'Weekly Lines are paid a tiered bonus based on order count within a given week. Paid upon Line Activation.' Bands = orders in the Sun-Sat SALE week -> $ per activated port line of those orders. Reproduces every Tier Volume Bonus row on the WE 10.25 + WE 11.1 deposits (Smedra 4 orders 10/19-10/25 incl. Guevara -> $30; 6 orders + the 10/31 double day = 7 -> $75; Andrew 4 -> $30; Jacob's upgrade-only order did not count). DNQ (0-30 day churn > 7% at 20+ activations, or activation rate < 60% at 20+ sales) is NOT modeled.
rep_tier.counts: orders with at least one port line (BYOD or not); upgrade-only and Air-only orders do not count
rep_tier._double_days_note: SEED only: nds_metrics/double_tier.py reads Sean's 'Double Tier Bonus - <date>' emails off Raf's inbox every run and caches them in output/nds_metrics/double_tier_days.json; this list is the floor for days before the reader existed.
